Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 3

“Behold, O teacher, this great army of the sons of Pandu, arrayed by your own gifted disciple, the son of Drupada.”

Duryodhana needles Drona with an uncomfortable irony — the army opposing them was organized by Dhrishtadyumna, Drona's own former student. Old loyalties and present enmities tangle from the very first verses.
